name: Power Of God The
overview: The power of God is vividly demonstrated in Scripture as both mighty and purposeful, evidenced by His ability to perform what seems impossible, such as the promise to Sarah that she would bear a son (Genesis 18:14). This power is manifest in His sovereign hand and finger, which bring judgment and deliverance alike, exemplified in the plagues upon Egypt and the defeat of enemies (Exodus 8:19; 9:3, 15-16; 15:6). God's power is not only great and glorious but also serves to establish His name and govern all things according to His will.
